name: orderly-monorepo
description: Production-grade microservices monorepo for Orderly Food Delivery Platform

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "GW,AUTH,REST,ORDER,NOTIF,FE" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:identity" "npm run dev:restaurant" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/gateway && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../../services/identity-service && npm install && cd ../restaurant-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
